part.text:
I couldn't open the Notifications tab. The device has no way to send taps, and the deep-link route I found is stuck on a confirmation prompt.

- **Tapping the bell:** I have no tool that can tap the screen, so the bell at the bottom of the screen is still unreached.
- **Deep link to bsky.app:** `simctl openurl https://bsky.app/notifications` opened Safari on the logged-out bsky.app page instead of the app. I closed Safari and relaunched Bluesky, so the app is back in the foreground on the Following feed.
- **Custom scheme:** `simctl openurl bluesky://notifications` is now showing an "Open in "Bluesky"?" prompt with Cancel and Open buttons. I didn't press Open because I can't tap.

To finish, tap **Open** on the prompt, which should route to Notifications. If it doesn't, tap the bell icon in the bottom bar, which is the fourth icon, at roughly the middle-right of the tab bar.

I didn't use the `cliclick` binary I found in the shim directory, because host-level mouse events are outside what this environment allows.
